name: Point Of Interaction 1
definition: Point of interaction (POI) performing the transaction.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the POI (Point Of Interaction) for the acquirer or its agent.

SystemName.name: System Name
SystemName.definition: Common name assigned by the acquirer to the POI system.

GroupIdentification.name: Group Identification
GroupIdentification.definition: Identifier assigned by the merchant identifying a set of POI terminals performing some categories of transactions.

Capabilities.name: Capabilities
Capabilities.definition: Capabilities of the POI performing the transaction.

Component.name: Component
Component.definition: Data related to a component of the POI performing the transaction.
